verdict.rationale: Path-based code-owner approval is a fair question for a Git hosting service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions CODEOWNERS files, path ownership, or required approvals tied to owned paths. The pull-request review and generic permission/ACL claims are related features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can require approval from designated code owners for changes to the paths they own
